caption: The drawing depicts a wooden-framed window divided into six rectangular panes, with a light blue sky visible through the glass. Covering the window is a set of curtains, consisting of two long panels that hang down on either side and a valance at the top. The curtains and valance are decorated with a brown floral and swirl pattern overlaying a beige or cream background with vertical stripes. The darker brown pattern appears to be lacy or semi-transparent, allowing some of the window and sky behind to be faintly visible through the material. The image is signed "M. Arnold" in the bottom right corner. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects present.
title: Drapery
